payload.body: Initial host audit: Scope already auto-binds when 'scope agent register' runs inside a detectable Codex/Claude session, but no installed global or project lifecycle hook invokes registration. Claude Code supports SessionStart (startup/resume/clear) and SessionEnd hooks; current ~/.claude/settings.json and Scope project settings contain no hooks. Claude Desktop/Cowork sessions require a separate capability check because they may not expose the same hook environment. Codex needs host-supported lifecycle integration rather than filesystem polling.
payload.author: codex:lifecycle-integration
